This page holds the constructs where the Rust converter is known to print something different from Turndown, so the differences stay written down and any new one is caught.

Angle brackets in text: use <angle> marks and a <b> tag name, plus 1 < 2 and a </closing> tag.

An empty link before text.

A break
then a new source line.

A path in ~/projects and a range n-i.
